description: Adversarial LIKE-semantics fixture (contract/SEMANTICS.md): every query separates two readings of a pattern that a buggy matcher would conflate — '_' as one byte vs zero/two, escaped vs wildcard metacharacters, anchored vs unanchored gaps, ordered multi-gap, and byte-vs-codepoint on multibyte data. Paired literal/pattern queries (contains.abc, multigap.literal, prefix.ab, suffix.c) must bless to identical truth: that is the lowering equivalence, checked by data rather than by proof.
